Download the **openseo-…-chrome.zip** file from Assets below. The automatic **Source code** archives require a build first.

### Install

1. Extract the ZIP into a folder you will keep.
2. Open `chrome://extensions` and enable **Developer mode**.
3. Select **Load unpacked**, then select the extracted folder containing `manifest.json`.
4. Open a website and select OpenSEO. Connect a [glasser Key](https://app.glasser.ai/keys?utm_source=openseo&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=onboarding&utm_content=release) in Settings.

This is a production build with no DEV badge. Paid lookups use your glasser balance.

To update, close OpenSEO, replace the files in the same extracted folder with the new release, and select **Reload** at `chrome://extensions`. Keep the same folder to preserve the extension identity and saved settings. Updates are manual.

`SHA256SUMS` contains the archive checksum.
